answer: An identity earns its seat through conviction voting with time-weighted support, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 6435 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the gale up to the light, weigh the juniper of the attack, and keep the umber of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
